summary_bullets: Prevent orphaned Step 3 review loops when the wrapper exits
Fail closed with a fresh panel-failed envelope when process-group isolation is unavailable
Pin the wrapper kill, wait, and stale-envelope invariants in the structure harness
commit_message:
Prevent orphaned Step 3 review loops

Run the Step 3 review loop in a job-control process group, trap wrapper exits to terminate the loop group, and perform final teardown after the wait. Fail closed before launch with a fresh panel-failed envelope when monitor mode cannot be verified, and pin the orphan-prevention invariants in the design structure test.
